questionnaire.title: QUESTIONNAIRE: Use of AI in marketing and promotion

questions.title: Do you consent to voluntarily participate in this anonymous study?
During the past 12 months, have you worked in marketing or promotional activities?
In which country do you carry out most of your marketing or promotional work?
Which option best describes your work?
options: I work at a marketing or advertising agency
I work in an in-house marketing team
I run my own business and manage its marketing

questions.title: How long have you worked in marketing or promotion?
How many people work in the organisation for which you perform most of your marketing activities?
During the past 12 months, have you used AI in marketing or promotional work?
How often do you use AI in marketing or promotional work?
Which types of AI tools do you use?
options: Text generation (e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot)
Image or video creation (e.g. Midjourney, DALL·E, Canva AI)
AI in advertising or marketing automation systems

questions.title: For which marketing tasks do you use AI?
options: I do not perform this type of task
rows: Audience and market analysis
Strategy, goals, and KPI planning
Segmentation, personas, and personalisation
Writing promotional content
Creating or editing images and video
Running or optimising advertising campaigns
Audience communication, customer service, and chatbots
Results analysis and reporting

questions.title: To what extent do you agree with the following statements?
rows: AI helps me complete marketing tasks faster
AI helps me tailor communication to audiences
AI helps me create more ideas and content
AI makes data analysis and decision-making easier
AI improves the quality of prepared materials
questions.section: IV. Effects, barriers, and responsible use

questions.title: How significant are the following barriers for you?
rows: Incorrect or fabricated AI outputs
Data protection and confidentiality
Copyright and legal compliance
Content that does not match the brand’s style or quality
Biased or discriminatory outputs
Lack of skills or clear procedures
Costs or difficulties with implementation and integration
questions.section: IV. Effects, barriers, and responsible use

questions.title: What do you or your organisation do to reduce risks related to AI?
options: Content is reviewed by a person
We do not enter confidential or personal data into AI tools
Materials are approved by a supervisor or client
We use training or internal AI guidelines
We disclose the use of AI when required
We do not use formal practices
I do not use AI / not applicable — select only this answer
questions.section: IV. Effects, barriers, and responsible use
exclusive: I do not use AI / not applicable — select only this answer

questions.title: Have you taken part in training on the use of AI in marketing or communication?
options: No, and I do not plan to
questions.section: IV. Effects, barriers, and responsible use

questions.title: If you wish, briefly describe one benefit, one problem, or one condition for the responsible use of AI in marketing.

questionnaire.description: This questionnaire is part of an international study. It is intended for people who have worked in marketing or promotional activities during the past 12 months, regardless of the country in which they work. Participation is voluntary and anonymous. We do not collect information that directly identifies you. Results will be analysed only in aggregate. The questionnaire takes about 5-6 minutes. In this questionnaire, "AI" means tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, Canva AI, and AI features in advertising and marketing systems.
